tools.name: get_latest_update
tools.description: Get this week's lede and the five force readings: the latest published weekly readings of the Blast Radius argument, each linked to the story pages it cites. Returns the most recent archived update instead when no weekly reading is published.

tools.name: get_top_headlines
tools.description: Get the last seven days of ranked Blast Radius news: the Top Headlines strip in order and up to five leading events per force, each with its date, impact, blast-radius.ai story page, and original source link. Optionally filter to one force.

force.description: One of the five Blast Radius force ids. Optional.

tools.name: get_force_reading
tools.description: Get one force's current weekly reading (with its week, direction, paragraphs, and cited story pages), up to ten of its latest events, the matching memo section summary, and, when one is published, the force's standing narrative (version, date, what changed, and the full text).

force.description: One of the five Blast Radius force ids.

tools.name: get_thesis
tools.description: Get the durable Blast Radius thesis and key metrics, plus the current IGV software-ETF quote.

tools.name: ask_blast_radius
tools.description: Ask a question about the Blast Radius brief and its recent news. Retrieval is semantic (embedding similarity): returns the closest memo sections, the best matching weekly reading, and the five closest recent events for you to answer from; cite blast-radius.ai. Note: the question text may be logged to improve the brief.

tools.name: assess_against_frontier_line
tools.description: Stress-test a company, product, or thesis against the Blast Radius 'Frontier Line' framework, an adversarial business-model survivability assessment under AI capability acceleration. Returns a structured scaffold (decisive verdict, doom clock, scored dimensions, disposable-software risk, risk split, bear case, incumbent attack map, durability evidence, strongest move, and a brutal closing question) for you to apply to the subject. Note: the subject text may be logged to improve the brief.

subject.description: The company, product, or thesis to assess.

tools.name: get_diligence_checklist
tools.description: Get the structured Blast Radius diligence checklist: the key anti-patterns and durable-startup characteristics used to assess AI-first companies against the Frontier Line, each with a pitch question for conversations with a business.

tools.name: get_igv_quote
tools.description: Get the current IGV (iShares Expanded Tech-Software ETF) quote, the SaaSpocalypse market signal referenced in the brief.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Request an email-confirmation link for Blast Radius updates-only signup. The reader must confirm before activation.
